summary: Iteration 41 - Tested Plan Limits Enforcement end-to-end. BACKEND: 9/9 pytest passed including (a) login regression for all 3 roles, (b) GET /api/company-admin/plan-usage returns full payload shape for both starter and enterprise plans, (c) POST /api/company-admin/compounds returns 403 with detail={code:'plan_limit_compounds', message:<arabic>, current_plan:'starter', current_plan_name_ar:'مجاني', current_count:1, max_allowed:1} when at limit, (d) POST /api/company-admin/compounds/{id}/users role=resident returns 403 with detail.code='plan_limit_residents' when at limit (test temporarily patched plan_limits.py starter.max_residents=1 with hot reload, restored after). FRONTEND: login flows work for all 3 roles; session switcher handled. PWA service worker + cache updates logged. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND (P0): CompanyPlanUsageCard is mounted inside /app/frontend/src/components/AdminDashboard.js line 339 behind `user.role === 'company_admin'`, BUT the router at App.js line 831 routes company_admin users to <CompanyAdminDashboard /> (pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js) instead of AdminDashboard — so the card is NEVER rendered for testcompany2. data-testid='company-plan-usage-card' is not in the DOM on the login-landing dashboard. Consequently upgrade-plan-btn is also absent and the manual-open path for the upgrade dialog cannot be exercised. The Axios 403 interceptor (GlobalUIProvider.js) and openUpgradeDialog CustomEvent wiring are correct by code review (interceptor guards status===403 && detail.code.startsWith('plan_limit_') and dispatches a CustomEvent that the listener picks up to mount <PlanUpgradeDialog />). Toasters (sonner + react-hot-toast) + PWAInstallPrompt + PlanUpgradeDialog are all mounted once inside GlobalUIProvider.

ui_bugs.issue: CompanyPlanUsageCard is not rendered on the dashboard that company_admin users actually see. DashboardRouter in App.js:831 returns <CompanyAdminDashboard /> for role==='company_admin', but CompanyPlanUsageCard is only mounted in AdminDashboard.js:339. Add `import CompanyPlanUsageCard from '../components/CompanyPlanUsageCard';` to pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js and render <CompanyPlanUsageCard /> near the top of the dashboard so the plan-usage widget + upgrade-plan-btn appears for testcompany2.

integration_issues.issue: Unable to fully exercise via UI because (1) the CompanyPlanUsageCard + upgrade-plan-btn do not appear on CompanyAdminDashboard and (2) the 'إضافة مجمع' modal in CompanyAdminDashboard.js uses inputs without type=text / placeholder attribute so its name field didn't accept fill via scripted selectors — the submit triggered client-side 'اسم المجمع مطلوب' validation, not the backend 403. Once the first UI bug is fixed, the interceptor path can be verified by clicking upgrade-plan-btn directly. Interceptor code itself in GlobalUIProvider.js lines 29-48 is correct.

action_items: HIGH: Import and render <CompanyPlanUsageCard /> inside /app/frontend/src/pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js (the dashboard that company_admin users actually land on). Currently it lives only in components/AdminDashboard.js which this role never sees.

MEDIUM: Add data-testid='compound-form-name-input' (or similar) + placeholder='اسم المجمع' to the compound-name input inside CompoundFormModal in pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js so automated tests can reliably fill it.
LOW: pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js already has an 'إضافة مجمع' button — consider adding a data-testid='add-compound-btn' for stability.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/plan_limits.py is clean: structured HTTPException with explicit 'code' discriminator is exactly what the frontend interceptor expects. _PLAN_LIMITS mirrors owner_subscriptions.py; worth adding a single-source-of-truth import to prevent drift.

routes/company_admin.py correctly calls assert_can_add_compound before insert and assert_can_add_resident only when role='resident' (not for manager/admin/security which don't count toward the plan). Clean.

GlobalUIProvider.js is well structured: interceptor ejects on unmount, CustomEvent-based listener avoids prop drilling. One minor nit — if this component mounts inside a React.StrictMode tree in dev it will register/unregister the interceptor twice, which is harmless but noisy. No production impact.

CompanyPlanUsageCard.js — good data-testid coverage, handles max == -1 (unlimited) correctly, shows both current/max for compounds and residents. Minor nit: PlanUpgradeDialog currentPlan default is 'starter' but dispatched event may pass undefined if backend omits current_plan — already guarded by `|| 'starter'` in interceptor line 41 and provider line 61.

CRITICAL: AdminDashboard.js:337 vs DashboardRouter at App.js:824-831. company_admin role is routed to CompanyAdminDashboard so the `user.role==='company_admin' && <CompanyPlanUsageCard />` inside AdminDashboard is dead code for that role. Move the mount to pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest incl. real 403 response structure for both compound + resident)
success_rate.frontend: 50% — login, dashboard load, toasters mount, GlobalUIProvider wiring all OK; CompanyPlanUsageCard itself cannot be exercised because it is never rendered on the CompanyAdminDashboard that company_admin lands on

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of missing plan-usage card in the UI: DashboardRouter in /app/frontend/src/App.js (line 824-831) branches on user.role and renders <CompanyAdminDashboard /> for company_admin. Meanwhile <CompanyPlanUsageCard /> is only mounted inside /app/frontend/src/components/AdminDashboard.js (line 339) behind a `user.role === 'company_admin'` guard — which is unreachable because company_admin users are routed elsewhere. Fix: add the import + render in /app/frontend/src/pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js. Reproduction: login testcompany2 → /app/dashboard → no data-testid='company-plan-usage-card' in DOM (verified).
